sources.snippet: Overview Working implementation of Tiny Transformer for Matching using a tiny configuration. The repository focuses on transparent code and repeatable smoke tests; benchmark claims are deliberately omitted.

sources.title: GitHub - atharvanaik06/tiny-transformer-lab: Build a GPT-style ...
sources.snippet: It is to make the mechanics of transformers and alignment concrete: build each major piece, train small models locally, change one variable at a time, and measure what actually improves. The model uses PyTorch tensors and automatic differentiation, but no prebuilt transformer implementation.

sources.title: GitHub - skolouri/TinyTransformer: Mathematics of AI - Transformer ...
sources.snippet: Tiny Transformer This repository contains a minimal yet functional implementation of a Transformer architecture featuring both an encoder and a decoder. The design prioritizes clarity and simplicity, making it an ideal resource for educational purposes and experimentation in both vision and natural language processing (NLP) applications.

sources.title: Transformer Lab - Primus: the world's first fully autonomous AI researcher
sources.snippet: Primus is the world's first fully autonomous AI researcher available to everyone. It hypothesizes, reads the literature, codes, runs experiments on real compute, draws conclusions, and writes the paper.

sources.snippet: Transformer has been adopted to image recognition tasks and shown to outperform CNNs and RNNs while it suffers from high training cost and computational complexity.
